**Issue #3351 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3351: Patch: the living game on a phone: a pass at 390x844 and on a throttled CPU over every look, animation and sound #3330 adds, with one budget they share
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3339, #3340, #3341, #3342, #3344, #3345, #3347, #3348, #3334, #3336, #3337 and #3338.

The owner asked that all of this look good on a phone too, not only on a computer. Each part under #3330 checks itself at 390x844. This part checks them **together**, on the board a real game produces, and sets the one budget they share.

### What it should be

1. **A full-board scenario at phone size.** Add a component spec (`e2e/cypress/component/`) or e2e spec that plays, at 390x844, 360x780 and a phone on its side, with the CPU throttled 4x (Chrome DevTools Protocol `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate`). The board holds:
   - five art-first Units, two Legendary and one Mythic among them, with tile auras;
   - an Anomaly's backdrop;
   - a launched Starship;
   - a hand of ten, one tilted.

   Through it play a Mythic takeover, a Starship launch and broadside, a Drone Battleship arrival, a Terminus set piece, a hand-to-tile flight and a riffle, and measure frame times throughout.
2. **One shared budget.** Moving faces, tile auras, backdrops, particles and tilt share one budget on a phone, `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` in `fx/constants.ts`. The adaptive cap (`FX_ADAPT_*`, `director.ts`) sheds in a named order when frames run long:
   - motes first;
   - then far auras;
   - then the moving faces furthest from the pointer;
   - never a set piece's main beats.

   The mean frame stays under `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`, and the worst under `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` (proposed and ruled).
3. **Fixes.** Fix what the scenario finds in the part that owns it. If the fix belongs to a part still open, write a short note on that part instead.
4. **Layout.** The one-screen rule (R1581000) and the tap areas (R2122000) hold with all of it on: e2e `46` and `47`, plus a long-press check that inspect and the full-screen view (#3345) open from every board face and hand card.

## Acceptance

- The scenario runs at the three sizes under 4x throttling, within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` mean and `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` worst.
- The shed order is tested: a forced slow frame sheds motes first and set-piece beats never.
- e2e `46`, `47` and the long-press check pass with every part's features on.
- The pull request lists each finding and where it was fixed or noted.
- Any ruling is in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`. The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42572112766)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Ship the phone pass for #3330 as one integration: a component spec (`e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`) that plays six moments on a full living board at 390x844, 360x780 and 844x390 (phone on its side) under 4x CPU throttling and holds a mean frame within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` and a worst frame within a new ruled `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`. Add the one shared budget both as constants (`PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` in `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts`) and as behavior: the director's adaptive cap sheds motes, then far auras, then moving faces furthest from the pointer, never a set piece's main beats. Extend the long-press coverage so inspect and the full-screen view open from every board face and hand card, keep e2e `46`/`47` green with everything on, and fix each finding in its owning part (or leave a note on the still-open part's issue).

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` | new | Full-board scenario: board fixture, six moments, frame sampling, mean/worst asserts at three sizes under throttling |
| `spec/rulings/R3351000.md` | new | Ruling: shared phone motion budget, shed order, worst-frame budget, `proven_in` |
| `spec/pending/3351.md` | new | §11 paragraph for R3351000 |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts` | change | Add `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` (rule 9 comments) |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts` | change | Pin the two new constants |
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts` | change | `adapt()`: named shed stages 0–3 in the ruled order; set-piece cues exempt |
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts` | change | Shed-order tests: forced slow frame sheds motes first; stages progress; set-piece beats never shed |
| `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx` | change | Read the director's shed level each frame; scale mote emission, dim far auras, still far faces |
| `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` | change | Long-press check: inspect + full-screen view from every board face and hand card |
| Owning part's files (unknown until the scenario runs) | change if needed | Fixes the scenario finds, each in the part that owns it |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; anything under `crates/` (no engine change: presentation only, rule 7); `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` and `47-tap-areas.cy.ts` (run, not edited); no test weakened, no timeout raised, no ruling removed. Governing spec: R1581000 (one screen), R2122000 (tap areas), R2803000 (phone budget precedent), R2785000 (set pieces), R3340000 (motion slots), R3342000 (tile aura), R3344001 (tilt), R3345000 (takeover/fullscreen), R3334001/R3334002 (starship), R3336000 (battleship), R3338000 (terminus). Ruling block for this issue is R3351000–R3351999 (free; verified no `R3351*` note exists).

## Steps

1. Read before editing: `spec/rulings/R1581000.md`, `R2122000.md`, `spec/pending/3340.md` (R3340000), `spec/pending/3345.md` (R3345000), `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx` (props around `FxLayerProps`), `apps/web/src/fx/aura/plan.ts` (`planAuras`, `auraBudget`), `apps/web/src/fx/aura/tile.ts` (`planTileAuras`), and the motion-slot ranking (`COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX`; ranked `useArtMotion` in `apps/web/src/cards/`). Confirm the exact seam where the director can publish a shed level the layer reads.
2. `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts`: after `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`, add `export const FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS = 120;` (worst single frame at ~8 fps; ruled by R3351000) and `export const PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET = 6;` (moving faces + tile auras + backdrops + particles + tilt share six concurrent motion units on a phone; count faces as 1 each, each aura as 1, tilt as 1). Rule-9 comments citing R3351000 on each.
3. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, `adapt()`: replace the bare halve-the-cap with stages `0` (full) → `1` (motes: halve particle emission) → `2` (far auras: halve aura/tile-aura intensity) → `3` (moving faces furthest from the pointer: pause). Advance one stage per slow window (same `FX_ADAPT_WINDOW`/`slowMs` trip condition), recover one stage per `FX_ADAPT_RECOVER_WINDOWS` healthy windows. Track the pointer via the existing pointer position the layer already keeps for tilt; distance is from pointer to face center. Cues belonging to an active set piece (`data-set-piece` holds: starship, anomaly, voidFold, diceOfDoom, nether) are exempt at every stage.
4. `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx`: each frame read the director's shed level and apply it: level ≥ 1 scales `particles.emit` counts; level ≥ 2 passes halved intensity into `planAuras`/`planTileAuras`; level ≥ 3 stills moving faces beyond `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, furthest-from-pointer first, reusing the `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` ranking with Mythics/attackers still first. Expose the level on the director object for tests (e.g. `shedLevel()`).
5. `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`: copy `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`'s `sampleFrames`, `summary`, `mountScene` verbatim. Board: `tileBoardView()` from `apps/web/src/test/tileBoard.ts` for tile auras, plus five art-first Units (two Legendary, one Mythic; reuse `fx-phone-frame`'s Mythic defIds `meditative-049`, `stinkyscape-006`, `-074`, `-086`, `-109` and two Legendary from the tile fixture's eligible units), one Anomaly backdrop (`stinkyscape-t-anomaly-found`), one launched Starship (`stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship`, `launched: 1`), a hand of ten with one tilted (copy the R3344001 tilt + circling-pointer pattern). Through it play, in order: Mythic takeover (`meditative-049` play events), Starship launch (`awakened` + `starshipLaunched`) and broadside (`attackDeclared` with the eight-gun piece list), Drone Battleship arrival (`stinkyscape-036` + three layers), Terminus set piece (`core-100` Ceaseless Void fold), a hand-to-tile flight (`hold` cue from a hand anchor; see `cues.ts` `ghost()`), and a riffle (pattern in `apps/web/src/game/animations.riffle.test.ts`). Keep game audio cues on (no new audio code). Sample frames across all six moments.
6. Same spec: loop the three sizes `[{390,844},{360,780},{844,390}]`; per size set 4x throttling with `cy.then(() => Cypress.automation("remote:debugger:protocol", { command: "Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate", params: { rate: 4 } }))` (pattern: `full-art-board.cy.tsx`'s `Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled` call), and reset to `rate: 1` in `afterEach`. Assert each sample's mean ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` and worst single frame ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`, reusing the `holdsBudget` retry shape for the mean; worst is asserted on the passing attempt's sample.
7. `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx`: add `it("R3351000 a long press opens inspect and the full-screen view from every board face and hand card")`: mount the living-game board, press-and-hold (`FULLSCREEN_HOLD_MS = 450` in `apps/web/src/cards/constants.ts`; `useFullScreenTrigger` in `apps/web/src/cards/index.ts`) on each of the five units, the launched Starship, and each of ten hand cards, asserting the inspect view then the full-screen host opens and closes on release.
8. Run e2e `46` and `47` unchanged against a build with every #3330 part on; fix any failure in the owning part's stylesheet/component, never in the specs.
9. Triage every finding: fix it in the part that owns it; if that part's issue is still open, leave a short note on that issue instead and cite it. List each finding and where it went in the pull request body.
10. Write `spec/rulings/R3351000.md` (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in` listing the new spec, `director.test.ts`, `constants.test.ts`; body: budget numbers, shed order, set-piece exemption, Hearthstone semantics line if the spec is silent) and `spec/pending/3351.md` (§11 paragraph only).

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts`, `it("R3351000 the shared phone motion budget and worst-frame budget")`: `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` is 6; `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` is 120, greater than `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` (50) and ≤ 250. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/constants.test.ts`.
- `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts`, `it("R3351 a forced slow frame sheds motes first")`: pump slow frames (copy the B34 `frameEvery(40, …)` trip pattern), assert emission halved while auras/faces untouched. `it("R3351 shedding continues far auras, then faces furthest from the pointer")`: further slow windows dim auras then still the far face while the near-pointer face moves. `it("R3351 a set piece's main beats never shed")`: with a set-piece hold active, all stages leave its cues firing. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/director.test.ts`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`, `it("R3351 the living game holds the phone budget at <size> under 4x throttling")` per size plus the shed-order integration `it("R3351 a forced slow frame sheds motes first and set-piece beats never")`. Run `pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` long-press `it(...)`. Run its component command.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Scenario runs at all three sizes under 4x throttling: mean ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`, worst ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`.
- [ ] Shed order unit-tested: motes first, far auras, far faces; set-piece beats never shed.
- [ ] E2e `46`, `47`, and the long-press check pass with every part's features on.
- [ ] Pull request lists each finding with its fix location or part-issue note.
- [ ] Ruling note + `spec/pending/3351.md` paragraph exist; web tests, typecheck, eslint, `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- [ ] No forbidden path touched; no check weakened; decisions not in the task recorded.

## Risks

- CDP throttling needs a Chrome-family browser; if CI's Cypress browser lacks `remote:debugger:protocol`, the spec errors instead of silently passing — verify the e2e browser config first, never gate the asserts on protocol availability.
- Frame times are noisy on shared runners: the `holdsBudget` lowest-of-three retry shape (already accepted in `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`) applies to the mean only; the worst-frame assert rides on the passing attempt.
- The shed level must not leak hidden information or affect rules: it only scales emissions/intensity/motion (rule 7 safe); keep all emission counts deterministic from the seeded rng.
- Landscape 844x390 may trip R1581000's under-501px-tall exemption (page may scroll there); the board is not a menu, so assert the board's own region instead of the document.

## Open questions

- None blocking. Assumed reversible defaults, recorded in the steps: worst budget 120 ms, shared budget 6 motion units, three sizes exact, CDP rate 4 with reset in `afterEach`, one ruling R3351000. If the scenario measures a worst frame the hardware cannot hold, the builder reports the numbers rather than raising the constants.
```

## Goal

Ship the phone pass for #3330 as one integration: a component spec (`e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`) that plays six moments on a full living board at 390x844, 360x780 and 844x390 (phone on its side) under 4x CPU throttling and holds a mean frame within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` and a worst frame within a new ruled `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`. Add the one shared budget both as constants (`PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` in `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts`) and as behavior: the director's adaptive cap sheds motes, then far auras, then moving faces furthest from the pointer, never a set piece's main beats. Extend the long-press coverage so inspect and the full-screen view open from every board face and hand card, keep e2e `46`/`47` green with everything on, and fix each finding in its owning part (or leave a note on the still-open part's issue).

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx` | new | Full-board scenario: board fixture, six moments, frame sampling, mean/worst asserts at three sizes under throttling |
| `spec/rulings/R3351000.md` | new | Ruling: shared phone motion budget, shed order, worst-frame budget, `proven_in` |
| `spec/pending/3351.md` | new | §11 paragraph for R3351000 |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts` | change | Add `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` (rule 9 comments) |
| `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts` | change | Pin the two new constants |
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts` | change | `adapt()`: named shed stages 0–3 in the ruled order; set-piece cues exempt |
| `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts` | change | Shed-order tests: forced slow frame sheds motes first; stages progress; set-piece beats never shed |
| `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx` | change | Read the director's shed level each frame; scale mote emission, dim far auras, still far faces |
| `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` | change | Long-press check: inspect + full-screen view from every board face and hand card |
| Owning part's files (unknown until the scenario runs) | change if needed | Fixes the scenario finds, each in the part that owns it |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; anything under `crates/` (no engine change: presentation only, rule 7); `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` and `47-tap-areas.cy.ts` (run, not edited); no test weakened, no timeout raised, no ruling removed. Governing spec: R1581000 (one screen), R2122000 (tap areas), R2803000 (phone budget precedent), R2785000 (set pieces), R3340000 (motion slots), R3342000 (tile aura), R3344001 (tilt), R3345000 (takeover/fullscreen), R3334001/R3334002 (starship), R3336000 (battleship), R3338000 (terminus). Ruling block for this issue is R3351000–R3351999 (free; verified no `R3351*` note exists).

## Steps

1. Read before editing: `spec/rulings/R1581000.md`, `R2122000.md`, `spec/pending/3340.md` (R3340000), `spec/pending/3345.md` (R3345000), `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx` (props around `FxLayerProps`), `apps/web/src/fx/aura/plan.ts` (`planAuras`, `auraBudget`), `apps/web/src/fx/aura/tile.ts` (`planTileAuras`), and the motion-slot ranking (`COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX`; ranked `useArtMotion` in `apps/web/src/cards/`). Confirm the exact seam where the director can publish a shed level the layer reads.
2. `apps/web/src/fx/constants.ts`: after `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`, add `export const FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS = 120;` (worst single frame at ~8 fps; ruled by R3351000) and `export const PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET = 6;` (moving faces + tile auras + backdrops + particles + tilt share six concurrent motion units on a phone; count faces as 1 each, each aura as 1, tilt as 1). Rule-9 comments citing R3351000 on each.
3. `apps/web/src/fx/director.ts`, `adapt()`: replace the bare halve-the-cap with stages `0` (full) → `1` (motes: halve particle emission) → `2` (far auras: halve aura/tile-aura intensity) → `3` (moving faces furthest from the pointer: pause). Advance one stage per slow window (same `FX_ADAPT_WINDOW`/`slowMs` trip condition), recover one stage per `FX_ADAPT_RECOVER_WINDOWS` healthy windows. Track the pointer via the existing pointer position the layer already keeps for tilt; distance is from pointer to face center. Cues belonging to an active set piece (`data-set-piece` holds: starship, anomaly, voidFold, diceOfDoom, nether) are exempt at every stage.
4. `apps/web/src/fx/FxLayer.tsx`: each frame read the director's shed level and apply it: level ≥ 1 scales `particles.emit` counts; level ≥ 2 passes halved intensity into `planAuras`/`planTileAuras`; level ≥ 3 stills moving faces beyond `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET`, furthest-from-pointer first, reusing the `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` ranking with Mythics/attackers still first. Expose the level on the director object for tests (e.g. `shedLevel()`).
5. `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`: copy `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`'s `sampleFrames`, `summary`, `mountScene` verbatim. Board: `tileBoardView()` from `apps/web/src/test/tileBoard.ts` for tile auras, plus five art-first Units (two Legendary, one Mythic; reuse `fx-phone-frame`'s Mythic defIds `meditative-049`, `stinkyscape-006`, `-074`, `-086`, `-109` and two Legendary from the tile fixture's eligible units), one Anomaly backdrop (`stinkyscape-t-anomaly-found`), one launched Starship (`stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship`, `launched: 1`), a hand of ten with one tilted (copy the R3344001 tilt + circling-pointer pattern). Through it play, in order: Mythic takeover (`meditative-049` play events), Starship launch (`awakened` + `starshipLaunched`) and broadside (`attackDeclared` with the eight-gun piece list), Drone Battleship arrival (`stinkyscape-036` + three layers), Terminus set piece (`core-100` Ceaseless Void fold), a hand-to-tile flight (`hold` cue from a hand anchor; see `cues.ts` `ghost()`), and a riffle (pattern in `apps/web/src/game/animations.riffle.test.ts`). Keep game audio cues on (no new audio code). Sample frames across all six moments.
6. Same spec: loop the three sizes `[{390,844},{360,780},{844,390}]`; per size set 4x throttling with `cy.then(() => Cypress.automation("remote:debugger:protocol", { command: "Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate", params: { rate: 4 } }))` (pattern: `full-art-board.cy.tsx`'s `Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled` call), and reset to `rate: 1` in `afterEach`. Assert each sample's mean ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` and worst single frame ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`, reusing the `holdsBudget` retry shape for the mean; worst is asserted on the passing attempt's sample.
7. `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx`: add `it("R3351000 a long press opens inspect and the full-screen view from every board face and hand card")`: mount the living-game board, press-and-hold (`FULLSCREEN_HOLD_MS = 450` in `apps/web/src/cards/constants.ts`; `useFullScreenTrigger` in `apps/web/src/cards/index.ts`) on each of the five units, the launched Starship, and each of ten hand cards, asserting the inspect view then the full-screen host opens and closes on release.
8. Run e2e `46` and `47` unchanged against a build with every #3330 part on; fix any failure in the owning part's stylesheet/component, never in the specs.
9. Triage every finding: fix it in the part that owns it; if that part's issue is still open, leave a short note on that issue instead and cite it. List each finding and where it went in the pull request body.
10. Write `spec/rulings/R3351000.md` (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in` listing the new spec, `director.test.ts`, `constants.test.ts`; body: budget numbers, shed order, set-piece exemption, Hearthstone semantics line if the spec is silent) and `spec/pending/3351.md` (§11 paragraph only).

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/fx/constants.test.ts`, `it("R3351000 the shared phone motion budget and worst-frame budget")`: `PHONE_MOTION_BUDGET` is 6; `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS` is 120, greater than `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS` (50) and ≤ 250. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/constants.test.ts`.
- `apps/web/src/fx/director.test.ts`, `it("R3351 a forced slow frame sheds motes first")`: pump slow frames (copy the B34 `frameEvery(40, …)` trip pattern), assert emission halved while auras/faces untouched. `it("R3351 shedding continues far auras, then faces furthest from the pointer")`: further slow windows dim auras then still the far face while the near-pointer face moves. `it("R3351 a set piece's main beats never shed")`: with a set-piece hold active, all stages leave its cues firing. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/fx/director.test.ts`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`, `it("R3351 the living game holds the phone budget at <size> under 4x throttling")` per size plus the shed-order integration `it("R3351 a forced slow frame sheds motes first and set-piece beats never")`. Run `pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/fx-phone-living-game.cy.tsx`.
- `e2e/cypress/component/card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` long-press `it(...)`. Run its component command.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Scenario runs at all three sizes under 4x throttling: mean ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`, worst ≤ `FX_PHONE_FRAME_WORST_MS`.
- [ ] Shed order unit-tested: motes first, far auras, far faces; set-piece beats never shed.
- [ ] E2e `46`, `47`, and the long-press check pass with every part's features on.
- [ ] Pull request lists each finding with its fix location or part-issue note.
- [ ] Ruling note + `spec/pending/3351.md` paragraph exist; web tests, typecheck, eslint, `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- [ ] No forbidden path touched; no check weakened; decisions not in the task recorded.

## Risks

- CDP throttling needs a Chrome-family browser; if CI's Cypress browser lacks `remote:debugger:protocol`, the spec errors instead of silently passing — verify the e2e browser config first, never gate the asserts on protocol availability.
- Frame times are noisy on shared runners: the `holdsBudget` lowest-of-three retry shape (already accepted in `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`) applies to the mean only; the worst-frame assert rides on the passing attempt.
- The shed level must not leak hidden information or affect rules: it only scales emissions/intensity/motion (rule 7 safe); keep all emission counts deterministic from the seeded rng.
- Landscape 844x390 may trip R1581000's under-501px-tall exemption (page may scroll there); the board is not a menu, so assert the board's own region instead of the document.

## Open questions

- None blocking. Assumed reversible defaults, recorded in the steps: worst budget 120 ms, shared budget 6 motion units, three sizes exact, CDP rate 4 with reset in `afterEach`, one ruling R3351000. If the scenario measures a worst frame the hardware cannot hold, the builder reports the numbers rather than raising the constants.
